name: chatplayground-multi-model-sweep
why: First end-to-end prototype of the control kernel on a surface we do not own: a logged-in SPA in the user's own Chrome. Deliberately written as DATA so the same file runs against any surface (Electron, native, remote viewer) once a transport exists.

surface.measured: A11Y on this window returned 24 elements, all browser furniture, 0 page nodes -> resolver must fall to TEXT/API, not claim success

politeness.note: If LastPass or a Google account chooser appears, that is the user's decision, not ours: stop and ask.

steps.on_absent: already signed in (the normal case for the user's own Chrome profile)

steps.expect: at least one model panel present

steps.verify: caret present in the composer (typing one char and reading it back)
composer text contains the last 30 characters of the prompt
a user message bubble containing the first 30 characters of the prompt is visible in the transcript column
steps.note: Send is disabled until the composer has text - verify enabled state, do not click a disabled control

done_signature.stability: one poll is enough when a live region says '<model> finished responding'; TTFT alone is not sufficient because it appears while tokens still stream

steps.measured_2026_11_22: all three panels emitted Text '<model> finished responding'; TTFT 634 ms / total 851 ms and TTFT 338 ms / total 494 ms
steps.evidence_note: the footer strip 'TTFT 6.3s . 14s . 69 -> 1,427 + 1,072 reasoning tokens' is the per-panel done marker

steps.fallback: per-panel copy buttons, left to right, stitched in DOM order
steps.verify: clipboard length > 200 chars and contains every panel's model name

failure_modes: login wall appears -> stop, ask the user (never type credentials)
LastPass overlay steals the composer -> dismiss once (escape), re-focus, else stop
a panel errors -> record 'PANEL_ERROR: <model>' and continue; a partial sweep is still a result
done signature never appears -> after timeout, capture each panel and save; mark verdict UNFINISHED
Paste all missing -> fall back to per-panel copy; if both fail, OCR the panels
